description: This Java class, JEPUtil, provides utility methods for evaluating mathematical expressions using the JEP (Java Expression Parser) library. It offers methods to evaluate expressions with a single variable 'x' or multiple variables provided via a map, encapsulating the use of the JEP parser for expression evaluation within the larger RomRaider project.

classes.name: JEPUtil
classes.description: A utility class for evaluating mathematical expressions using the JEP library, containing static methods to facilitate expression parsing.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression with a single variable 'x' assigned to a specific value.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates a mathematical expression with multiple variables provided via a map of variable names to their respective values.
